source.notes:
The 6,000 most frequent Southern Vietnamese words, in frequency order.
Frequency: tabidots/vn-freqs: Leipzig Corpora Collection (1M mixed Vietnamese sentences) and OpenSubtitles 2016, segmented into words (not syllables) with pyvi. No Southern-only frequency list is openly available; Wiktionary labels such as "Southern Vietnam" are kept in the notes.
Disambiguation: UD Vietnamese VTB treebank (CC BY-SA 4.0), used only to choose each word's main part of speech (là: the copula)
Definitions and parts of speech: English Wiktionary, via the Wiktextract/Kaikki.org extraction in Vuizur/Wiktionary-Dictionaries (2022–23 snapshot; CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL)
Example sentences: Tatoeba (CC-BY-2.0-FR); UD Vietnamese VTB (CC-BY-SA-4.0); AI-written (Claude) (AI-generated, not checked by a native speaker); the source of every sentence is listed in vi-sentence-credits.tsv.
See docs/VOCABULARY_SOURCES.md for licences and attribution.
